tests.title: A customer cannot open another customer's order by changing the order number in the URL
tests.goal: Order details, receipts and addresses of one customer are never visible to another customer or a guest.
preconditions: Two QA members (A and B) from .env or created at runtime, each with at least one order
data: Order URLs of member B, read at runtime from B's My Orders

steps.text: Log in as member B and copy the URL of one order detail and its Upload Receipt tab
Log out, log in as member A and open those URLs
Log out and open the same URLs as a guest
Use Guest Order Tracking with B's order number and A's email

expected.text: Step 2: access denied or redirect to A's own orders; none of B's name, address, items or receipt is shown
